purpose: Teach: 州立/施主/廻っ/下層/席上/呼応/デマンド/無休

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、州立大学の研究室と提携しろ
lines.en: I want us to partner with the state university research lab.
lines.style: Direct, measured command. Clipped pace. No softening—this is a directive, not a request. Slight pause after the subject to let weight settle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。施主との打ち合わせを設定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll set up meetings with the client.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment. Quick intake breath before speaking. Professional, efficient tone. Each phrase lands clearly. No hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、工場を廻って点検しろ
lines.en: Go inspect the factory floor yourself. Check everything.
lines.style: Firm instruction. Slight emphasis on the action verbs. Steady pace, no rush—this is important. Expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の下層意識を改善します
lines.en: Understood. I'll work on improving morale and awareness among the staff.
lines.style: Assured response. Slightly faster than before—confidence in the commitment. No doubt in the delivery. Professional but personal investment showing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員会の席上で新方針を発表しろ
lines.en: Announce the new strategy at the executive meeting.
lines.style: Clear, controlled command. Slight weight on 'announce'—this is public-facing. Composed but urgent. No room for interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。需要に呼応した供給体制を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare the supply chain to match demand fluctuations.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Thoughtful pace—this is complex work. Confident but not casual. Shows he's processing the scope.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、デマンド予測の精度を上げろ
lines.en: Improve our demand forecasting accuracy. Make it sharper.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Slight punch on 'sharper'—precision matters. No ambiguity. Voice stays level and composed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。年中無休のサービスを検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll look into expanding to year-round service coverage.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slightly slower than previous responses—weight of the request sinks in. Respectful finish. Voice trails slightly, confirming understanding.
